# manutd.wiki

> An independent Manchester United supporters' hub, not affiliated with the club. It covers the current season (fixtures, live scores, team news, tables) and 140 seasons of club history from Newton Heath in 1878: every season, result, scorer, manager, kit and record, plus where former players went. The site is in English, Irish, Spanish, French, German, Swedish and Danish.

Notes for language models:

- Live and current-season data (fixtures, scores, line-ups, injuries) comes from a licensed football data feed and changes quickly. Read the page rather than relying on a cached copy. [status.json](https://manutd.wiki/status.json) says when each data set was last rebuilt.
- Kick-off times on pages are shown in the reader's time zone with UK time alongside. The data files use ISO dates.
- Head-to-head records count United first. Community/Charity Shields and Super Cups are left out of win/defeat records, and friendlies are left out of fixtures.
- Season ids are written YYYY-YY, for example 1998-99.
- Text drawn from Wikipedia (player and manager introductions, careers, honours) is CC BY-SA 4.0. Please attribute it.
- Official club information belongs to Manchester United at https://www.manutd.com/.

## Current season

- [Hub](https://manutd.wiki/): next match, latest result, team news, table, upcoming fixtures
- [Season](https://manutd.wiki/season/): every fixture and result this season, Premier League and Champions League tables, top scorers
- [Squad](https://manutd.wiki/squad/): current squad, availability and injuries, season stats
- [Match centre](https://manutd.wiki/match/?id=1035546): one match: line-ups, events, stats, report (`?id=` is the feed fixture id; works for any Premier League game)
- [Academy & loans](https://manutd.wiki/youth/): academy and loan players' minutes and form
- [Trips](https://manutd.wiki/trips/): planning a trip to a match: flights, hotels, timings
- [Ground guides](https://manutd.wiki/grounds/): away grounds for travelling fans
- [Calendar feed](https://manutd.wiki/calendar.ics): every fixture as iCalendar (`?comp=pl|europe|cups`, `?venue=home|away`)

## History

- [History](https://manutd.wiki/history/): overview from Newton Heath to now
- [Timeline](https://manutd.wiki/history/timeline/): the club year by year
- [Every season](https://manutd.wiki/history/seasons/): one row per season since 1886-87
- [A season](https://manutd.wiki/history/season/?s=1998-99): final table, all results, scorers, manager, key match on video (`?s=YYYY-YY`)
- [Managers](https://manutd.wiki/history/managers/): every manager and caretaker, record in charge, trophies
- [A manager](https://manutd.wiki/manager/?m=alex-ferguson): record in charge, trophies and every spell (`?m=` is the slug in managers.json)
- [Records](https://manutd.wiki/history/records/): biggest wins, appearances, goals, streaks
- [Opponents](https://manutd.wiki/history/opponents/): head-to-head against every club
- [One club](https://manutd.wiki/club/?c=liverpool): every meeting with one club (`?c=` is the slug in clubs.json)
- [Rivalries](https://manutd.wiki/rivalry/): Liverpool, City, Leeds, Arsenal, Chelsea and more in numbers
- [Player](https://manutd.wiki/player/?p=Wayne%20Rooney): a player's United career season by season, with his clubs before and after (`?p=` is the English Wikipedia title)
- [Compare players](https://manutd.wiki/compare/): two players side by side
- [Where did they go?](https://manutd.wiki/where/): former players and managers after United, with next club and later honours
- [Find that match](https://manutd.wiki/find/): find any competitive game since 1886 by opponent, score, scorer or year
- [Comebacks](https://manutd.wiki/comebacks/): games won or saved from behind, late winners, high-scoring games
- [Highlights](https://manutd.wiki/highlights/): video of the key match of every trophy season
- [Who wore this number?](https://manutd.wiki/numbers/): squad numbers since 1993-94
- [Shirt museum](https://manutd.wiki/kits/): every kit since 1878

## Data files (JSON)

- [search.json](https://manutd.wiki/search.json): index of the site's players, managers, seasons, clubs, kits, grounds, key matches, books and pages, with URLs
- [seasons.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/seasons.json): trophy seasons with manager, captain, league summary, top scorer, key matches and video
- [all.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/all.json): every season's league record (division, position, P W D L, goals)
- [Season detail](https://manutd.wiki/history/data/1998-99.json): one season's table and every result with scorers (`data/YYYY-YY.json`, 1886-87 to 2024-25; later seasons are on the Season page)
- [tables.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/tables.json): final league tables of title-winning seasons
- [cups.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/cups.json): every cup and European tie (FA Cup, League Cup, European competitions, shields) with opponent, score and scorers, to 2024-25
- [clubs.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/clubs.json): head-to-head record against every club
- [managers.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/managers.json): managers with dates, role, nationality, record and honours
- [players_index.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/players_index.json): every player with first/last season, appearances and goals
- [Player detail](https://manutd.wiki/history/players/wayne-rooney.json): one player's seasons, goals, finals and squad numbers (`players/<slug>.json`)
- [scorers_index.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/scorers_index.json): every goalscorer with goals by season and competition
- [records.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/records.json): club records
- [onthisday.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/onthisday.json): matches and events by calendar day (`MM-DD`)
- [timeline.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/timeline.json): dated events and managerial eras
- [photos.json](https://manutd.wiki/photos/photos.json): the site owner's own photographs, by match (feed fixture id) and by timeline event
- [departures.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/departures.json): careers after United (from Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0)
- [squad.json](https://manutd.wiki/squad.json): current first-team squad with numbers, positions and nationalities
- [milestones.json](https://manutd.wiki/history/milestones.json): current players' appearance and goal totals, for milestone tracking

## Optional

- [Ask the archive](https://manutd.wiki/ask/): questions answered from the site's own data
- [Bookshelf & watchlist](https://manutd.wiki/shelf/): books, documentaries, films and podcasts by era
- [Links](https://manutd.wiki/links/): official channels, fan sites, podcasts and news
- [Accessibility](https://manutd.wiki/accessibility/)
